name: Hanasaki Misaki
source:
A classmate of Yumeha’s who shares the same dorm room with her.
She has a somewhat reserved personality, but gets along well with Yumeha, who transferred in.
"Yume-chan, you're so easily moved. I never get tired of watching you."
